hero.headline: End-to-End Digital Governance for AICTE Security Deposits & Bank Guarantees
hero.purpose: Track every institution's security deposit, fixed deposit receipt (FDR), and bank guarantee from initial submission through tripartite lien verification to final discharge in one tamper-evident portal.

about.section_subtitle: Transitioning from fragmented physical paperwork to a unified national digital repository.
about.challenge_desc: Managing thousands of Fixed Deposit Receipts (FDRs) and Bank Guarantees across hundreds of technical institutions has historically relied on physical paper receipts, manual branch follow-ups, and fragmented registers. This created operational risks of missed maturity dates, delayed renewals, and administrative friction during rightful release.
about.solution_desc: Saksham establishes a unified single source of truth connecting technical institutions, scrutiny officers, issuing bank branches, and approving authorities. By combining automated maturity tracking, independent bank-verified tagging, and an immutable audit trail, the portal ensures complete transparency and regulatory compliance across every instrument's lifecycle.

lifecycle.section_subtitle: Every security deposit follows an 8-stage statutory lifecycle from initial upload to formal discharge.

modules.section_subtitle: Purpose-built functional components delivering end-to-end security deposit oversight.

verification.section_subtitle: What an institution submits remains strictly separated from what an issuing bank confirms.
verification.self_declared_body: When an institution submits a new FDR or Bank Guarantee, all details (FDR number, amount, maturity date, bank branch) are treated as Self-Declared. These entries are subject to scrutiny and cannot be treated as valid legal security until independently corroborated.
verification.bank_verified_body: Only after the issuing bank branch confirms the instrument—via official confirmation letter, digital lien marking, or bank API integration—is the instrument designated as Bank-Verified. This dual-state architecture prevents unauthorized or unencumbered submissions.

roles.section_subtitle: Four dedicated user roles governed by strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), supported by external banking verifiers.

smart_ai.section_subtitle: Advisory intelligence designed to reduce clerical burdens while preserving human authority.
smart_ai.ethical_notice: Statutory Decision Integrity: AI tools inside Saksham are strictly advisory. Officers and approving authorities retain sole authority for all regulatory decisions. AI models are trained on synthetic benchmark datasets in this prototype.

security.section_subtitle: Built strictly according to Indian e-Governance standards and data privacy mandates.

getting_started.section_subtitle: Simple role-specific workflows to begin utilizing the Saksham portal.

faqs.section_subtitle: Answers based on the actual architectural implementation and statutory operating rules.

contact.section_subtitle: Reach the AICTE Regulation Bureau or technical support team.
